candidate.title: 3P-Seq
candidate.scope: Single-route Illumina schematic of poly(A)-position profiling by sequencing (3P-Seq), interpreted at schematic scope using Jan et al.’s primary implementation. The route starts with already poly(A)-enriched RNA and depicts splint-mediated end tagging, T1 partial digestion, streptavidin capture, adaptor-primed dTTP-only tail extension and RNase H digestion, ending at a labelled cDNA product. The title icon is descriptive; no alternative workflow or branch is shown. The endpoint compresses subsequent RNA-to-library preparation, represented only as a broad, explicitly paper-supported interface. Associated kits, unshown applications and 2P-seq are not additional target methods.
